LegalVault: Zero-Knowledge Multi-Tenant Legal Evidence Management Platform

A secure cloud-based platform for managing legal cases and evidence with tenant isolation, encrypted storage and controlled access.

Next.js 15Node.jsAWS KMSDynamoDBAmazon S3
Contents
ObjectiveTechnology StackFeasibility AnalysisRequirementsSystem ArchitectureFailure StrategyConclusion

Objective

To develop a secure cloud-based platform that enables lawyers and law firms to manage legal cases and evidence while ensuring strict tenant isolation through a Multi-Tenant Encrypted DB Proxy Engine. The system uses AWS KMS for key management and stores encrypted data in cloud storage, ensuring that sensitive legal information remains inaccessible to database administrators and unauthorized tenants.

Feasibility Analysis

Technical Feasibility

The proposed system uses mature cloud-native technologies and managed AWS services. Multi-tenancy can be implemented using tenant identifiers, while encryption and decryption operations are handled through a custom proxy layer integrated with AWS KMS.

The project is technically achievable by a student team with support from agentic coding tools.

Failure & Edge Case Strategy

ScenarioImpactRecovery
Backend Server FailureRequests temporarily unavailableRestart service; no data loss
DynamoDB FailureCase metadata unavailableRetry mechanism; DynamoDB replication
S3 Upload FailureEvidence file not storedRollback metadata operation; retry upload
AWS KMS FailureEncryption/Decryption unavailableRetry request; fail securely without storing plaintext
Network PartitionClient cannot reach serverAutomatic retry; reconnection mechanism
JWT ExpirationAccess deniedRe-authentication
Cross-Tenant Access AttemptUnauthorized access requestProxy validates tenant ownership; return HTTP 403 Forbidden
File CorruptionFile cannot be decryptedIntegrity verification; re-upload from source copy
Service Crash During UploadPartial uploadCleanup incomplete objects; retry operation

Conclusion

LegalVault is a technically feasible cloud-native application that demonstrates secure multi-tenancy through a custom Multi-Tenant Encrypted DB Proxy Engine. By combining DynamoDB, S3, KMS, and JWT-based authentication, the system provides strong tenant isolation, encrypted evidence storage, and zero-knowledge data access while remaining achievable for a student development team using modern agentic coding tools.
